title: Power Asset Structural Record
description: Structural Power Asset graph node. Asset type, capacity, voltage, utility, dates, and operating characteristics belong exclusively in Facts.

id.description: Stable UUID used as the Power Asset graph node and Fact relationship target.

schema_version.description: Version of this structural Power Asset contract.

entity_type.description: Fixed collection discriminator used for deterministic typed references.

slug.description: Stable repository key; it is not an evidentiary asset name.

display_name.description: Non-authoritative interface label for navigation; never a sourced asset name.

company_id.description: Structural edge to the Company node responsible for this asset.

campus_id.description: Structural edge to the Campus node containing this asset.

project_id.description: Optional structural edge to a related Project node; null when no Project node applies.

created_at.description: UTC date-time when this structural graph node was created.

modified_at.description: UTC date-time of the latest permitted repository-administration update.

record_status.description: Repository-management state, not the asset's operating status.

administrative_notes.description: Optional repository-management note containing no asserted asset facts.
